name: Workflow Diagram Node
description: On-demand Agent guide for reading and writing Excalidraw Diagram nodes through typed backend actions only.

controlSurface.storage: Harness/a2a/component-nodes/**/state.json is backend-owned diagnostic storage, never an Agent control surface.
controlSurface.outputRouting: Prefer connected writable Diagram nodes for flowcharts, sketches, architecture maps, and visual plans.

prohibitions: Never edit `Harness/a2a/**/state.json` directly — use typed actions.
Never edit component-node state files or the workflow map file.
Never overwrite a scene without reading it first: readScene before saveScene or patchScene.
Never invent node actions that the backend does not expose; read this manual before acting.
